          Flight arrivals at Abha Regional Airport (AHB)

          When you land at Abha Regional Airport (AHB) in Abha, you’ll be greeted by a welcoming and well-organized terminal that ensures a smooth arrival experience. Abha Regional Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in Abha pleasant and convenient. Whether you’re continuing your travels or exploring Abha for the first time, Abha Regional Airport provides everything you need to start your visit comfortably.

           

          Discover Abha: Breathe in the Beauty of the City in the Clouds

          Ascend to Abha, where cool mountain breezes and vibrant violet jacarandas redefine your Arabian escape. Nestled high in the Sarawat Mountains, this mountain bride invites you to wander through historic mud-walled palaces, explore the artistic soul of Al-Muftaha Village, and soar over lush national parks by cable car. Experience a refreshing blend of heritage and nature in Saudi Arabia’s southwestern jewel. Welcome to our Future.


          1. Explore Al-Muftaha Village

          Admire vibrant local murals and traditional architecture in the heart of the city's cultural center. Local and regional artists exhibit their finest works in charming art galleries, providing an immersive look into regional identity.


          2. Walk The Fog Walkway

          Stroll through mist-covered mountain paths for a surreal journey amidst the clouds. The elevated path lets you touch the sky while taking in the cooling alpine climate, offering an unforgettable escape from the summer heat.


          3. Ride The Cable Car

          Soar high above the valley to enjoy panoramic, emerald-lit evening views of the city below. The dramatic ride delivers spectacular perspectives of the rugged terrain and pitched hills that embrace this high-altitude haven.


          4. Wander Down Art Street

          Stroll under a canopy of purple jacaranda blossoms surrounded by dynamic outdoor galleries. Step into lively cafes and admire open-air installations that showcase creative energy alongside beautiful seasonal blooms.


          5. Hike Asir National Park

          Discover pristine wilderness trails, diverse mountain bird species, and breathtaking cliffside vistas. Adventure seekers can climb high ridges to witness majestic ecosystems and sweeping views of the highland landscape.
